source_authority.relationship: The annex decomposes but does not supersede the canonical Atlas. CAD-001..CAD-069 are integration-owned parent IDs, not canonical Atlas IDs.

metadata_overrides.required_behavior: Bind one stable delivered asset/unit identity to one exact immutable release revision without copying release content.
metadata_overrides.positive_fixture: Create one synthetic unit/release binding, restart, and resolve the same exact release hash.
metadata_overrides.negative_fixture: Submit the same unit identity with a divergent release and assert duplicate-identity conflict with zero mutation.
metadata_overrides.failure_condition: A duplicate unit identity resolves to a different immutable release.

impact_edges: exact release/design/BOM/process revisions -> unit configuration baseline

metadata_overrides.required_behavior: Persist one content-addressed release/design/BOM/process baseline and explicit supersession for an exact unit.
metadata_overrides.positive_fixture: Resolve every exact baseline revision/hash before and after restart and append a separately hashed successor.
metadata_overrides.negative_fixture: Attempt an in-place baseline overwrite or inconsistent cross-revision set and assert zero mutation.
metadata_overrides.failure_condition: The baseline overwrites prior content or contains mutually inconsistent revisions.

impact_edges: synthetic source + unit + exact baseline -> immutable observation

metadata_overrides.required_behavior: Append one explicitly synthetic observation with source, unit, time and exact configuration-baseline reference.
metadata_overrides.positive_fixture: Append and replay a SYNTHETIC observation whose source, unit and baseline hashes all resolve.
metadata_overrides.negative_fixture: Submit LIVE, REAL, control, secret or private content and assert PRODUCT_BOUNDARY_VIOLATION with zero mutation.
metadata_overrides.failure_condition: The observation is not explicitly synthetic/public or its unit/baseline reference is invalid.

impact_edges: unit baseline + observation -> maintenance history event

metadata_overrides.required_behavior: Append one maintenance history record against the exact unit baseline without dispatch or control intent.
metadata_overrides.positive_fixture: Append a synthetic maintenance record and resolve its exact unit, baseline and source observation.
metadata_overrides.negative_fixture: Include dispatch, command or machine-control intent and assert a stable forbidden-effect diagnostic with zero mutation.
metadata_overrides.failure_condition: A maintenance record contains dispatch, command or machine-control intent.

impact_edges: exact observations + confidence -> immutable failure finding

metadata_overrides.required_behavior: Derive one failure finding from exact source observations and their confidence records.
metadata_overrides.positive_fixture: Recompute a finding from pinned observations/confidence and compare its canonical digest after reorder/restart.
metadata_overrides.negative_fixture: Omit or tamper a source/confidence reference and assert unsourced-finding rejection with zero finding.
metadata_overrides.failure_condition: A finding is unsourced or not bound to the exact confidence/source revisions.

impact_edges: exact observation IDs + method/source basis -> confidence classification

metadata_overrides.required_behavior: Validate confidence classification, method, basis and source for exact observation IDs.
metadata_overrides.positive_fixture: Validate declared MEASURED, INFERRED and UNKNOWN synthetic vectors with exact bases.
metadata_overrides.negative_fixture: Use out-of-range, unsupported or unsourced confidence and assert rejection without promoting UNKNOWN.
metadata_overrides.failure_condition: Confidence is out of range, unsupported or lacks an exact source/method basis.

metadata_overrides.required_behavior: Resolve exact versioned requirement, design, BOM and process trace links plus link rationale for one finding.
metadata_overrides.positive_fixture: Resolve a nontrivial cross-domain trace graph and independently match every exact revision/hash.
metadata_overrides.negative_fixture: Use transient, unversioned or unknown links and assert explicit unresolved diagnostics, never resolved state.
metadata_overrides.failure_condition: Any affected link is transient, unversioned, stale, ambiguous or falsely marked resolved.

impact_edges: finding + affected links -> human-reviewable triage disposition

metadata_overrides.required_behavior: Append one human-reviewable triage disposition without inferring authorization.
metadata_overrides.positive_fixture: Append a named-reviewer synthetic triage receipt bound to exact finding and trace hashes.
metadata_overrides.negative_fixture: Omit a named human decision or let the service self-authorize and assert triage remains pending.
metadata_overrides.failure_condition: Triage is presented as authorized without a distinct named-human decision receipt.

impact_edges: triage -> typed corrective proposal against exact released base

metadata_overrides.required_behavior: Create one typed, non-executable corrective proposal against an exact released base revision.
metadata_overrides.positive_fixture: Create and replay a proposal whose base, rationale and intended typed changes remain identical.
metadata_overrides.negative_fixture: Attempt a direct base edit, stale-base proposal or executable payload and assert rejection with release unchanged.
metadata_overrides.failure_condition: The proposal mutates its base, targets a stale base or carries executable content.

impact_edges: corrective proposal + trace graph -> conservative direct/transitive affected set

metadata_overrides.required_behavior: Deterministically compute direct/transitive affected nodes, unknowns, reviews and tests for one proposal.
metadata_overrides.positive_fixture: Shuffle one cyclic-edge-free fixture and reproduce the same stable affected/unknown/review/test sets.
metadata_overrides.negative_fixture: Inject an unknown or cycle and assert it is surfaced rather than silently treated as unaffected.
metadata_overrides.failure_condition: Unknowns/cycles are omitted, treated as unaffected or make the result order-dependent.

impact_edges: external human authorization + exact proposal/impact hash -> new parented change path

metadata_overrides.required_behavior: Bind a matching external named-human authorization and create a new parented change path without editing the release.
metadata_overrides.positive_fixture: Apply one matching unexpired human authorization to unchanged proposal/evidence and inspect the new parented branch receipt.
metadata_overrides.negative_fixture: Use agent-issued, missing, expired, mismatched or stale authorization and assert no branch/revision is created.
metadata_overrides.failure_condition: Authorization is absent, non-human, expired, mismatched or bound to stale proposal/evidence.

impact_edges: new change path -> unchanged prior release bytes/hash/revision

metadata_overrides.required_behavior: Verify the original released bytes, hash and revision remain unchanged after a successor path is created.
metadata_overrides.positive_fixture: Compare pre/post release bytes and hashes after a valid successor path and require exact equality.
metadata_overrides.negative_fixture: Tamper or overwrite any prior-release byte/ref and assert immutable-release violation.
metadata_overrides.failure_condition: Any prior released byte, hash, revision or parent relation changes in place.

impact_edges: operations event chain -> deterministic reconstructed state and provenance

metadata_overrides.required_behavior: Replay the complete operations-feedback event chain and validate ordering, provenance and hashes.
metadata_overrides.positive_fixture: Rebuild the same final state and graph digest in a clean process from the ordered immutable chain.
metadata_overrides.negative_fixture: Delete, reorder or tamper one event and assert replay failure at the exact stable event ID.
metadata_overrides.failure_condition: The event chain has a gap, reorder, cycle, provenance omission or hash mismatch.

impact_edges: triage -> no-action closure preserving finding and release

metadata_overrides.required_behavior: Append a no-action closure that preserves the finding and release and creates no change path.
metadata_overrides.positive_fixture: Close one synthetic finding as no-action and prove the finding/release remain resolvable and no proposal is applied.
metadata_overrides.negative_fixture: Attempt to hide/delete the finding or create a change through no-action closure and assert rejection.
metadata_overrides.failure_condition: No-action closure alters the finding/release or creates an implicit change path.

impact_edges: forbidden data/action kind -> stable rejection with zero external effect

metadata_overrides.required_behavior: Reject live/private/controlled data and dispatch, machine, supplier, production or external-effect actions.
metadata_overrides.positive_fixture: Run the complete forbidden-domain/action corpus and obtain stable ordered rejection codes with zero effects.
metadata_overrides.negative_fixture: Any accepted forbidden kind, external call, credential use or product-authority claim fails this leaf.
metadata_overrides.failure_condition: A forbidden data class, authority domain or external-effect action is admitted.

impact_edges: operations corrective proposal -> mission-requirements proposal boundary

metadata_overrides.required_behavior: Project an accepted operations corrective proposal into a distinct mission-requirements proposal boundary.
metadata_overrides.positive_fixture: Resolve an exact operations proposal ref without copying its mutable payload into mission authority.
metadata_overrides.negative_fixture: Let either lane overwrite or absorb the other lane's proposal and assert authority-domain rejection.
metadata_overrides.failure_condition: The mission edge duplicates, absorbs or mutates the operations-owned corrective proposal.
